name: c-e-r
title: C-E-R

categories.label: Claim
categories.description: A clear, arguable claim that answers the prompt and tells the reader what the student thinks.

categories.label: Evidence
categories.description: Specific evidence from the text or task that supports the claim and is explained, not just quoted.

categories.label: Reasoning
categories.description: Analysis that connects the evidence to the claim and shows why it proves the point.

promptConfig.gradingInstructions: Grade this C-E-R (Claim-Evidence-Reasoning) response on claim, evidence, and reasoning. Anchor your read in the assignment prompt when it is available. Reward clear thinking and specific support; do not expect full essay structure.

calibrationNotes: C-E-R (Claim-Evidence-Reasoning): grade claim, evidence, and reasoning as distinct moves.
